titles: AI Invoice Processing Agent with Approvals and Duplicate Checks
Invoice Automation: AI Extraction, Validation and Zoho Sync
AI Accounts Payable Agent for Zoho Books and Xero
role: AI automation developer: built the extraction, validation, duplicate checks, approvals and sync
description: Finance teams retype supplier invoices, pay duplicates twice and lose approvals in email. A demo build on sample data: invoices arrive by upload or email, AI reads every field with a confidence score, code checks the maths and purchase order match, duplicates are blocked, rules send each invoice to auto-approval or the right person, and approved bills post to the accounting system with a retry queue. Safeguards: nothing posts unapproved, every decision needs a reason and is logged. 59 automated tests. Stack: TypeScript, Next.js, SQLite, Claude Haiku and Sonnet.
